title: How to count occurrences of a substring in a cell
task: How many times a word or code appears inside one text value.
keywords: count occurrences of word in cell excel

excel.note: A2 = the text, B2 = the substring. Case-sensitive.

setup_cells.A2: the cat sat, the cat ran

explanation: Deleting every copy of the substring shortens the text by (count × substring length), so dividing the shrinkage by LEN(B2) recovers the count: removing both "cat"s drops 6 characters, 6/3 = 2. The single-character version is the comma-counting recipe. SUBSTITUTE is case-sensitive — wrap both haystack and needle in LOWER() for case-blind counting — and note overlapping matches ("aaa" containing "aa") count non-overlapping occurrences only.
